architecture.mechanism: Wavelet decomposition for feature extraction combined with temporal dependency capture using LSTM networks and refined estimates via SVR with DHGSO parameter optimization
architecture.intervention: Implement wavelet decomposition to extract features from retail demand data, use LSTM to capture temporal patterns in store assortment and pricing, apply SVR with optimized parameters to generate forecasts, and establish a monitoring system for feature drift detection
architecture.expected_effect: Detect forecast degradation within 7 days of onset at or above 15 percent WAPE inflation while maintaining false-positive rate below 5% without requiring retraining more than monthly
architecture.falsification_test: Compare WAPE inflation detection time and false-positive rate between the proposed system and the current system during controlled feature drift simulation scenarios
